name: sentinel-platform-v2
description: Independent Sentinel multi-tenant monitoring platform starter

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.dev:tilda: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix ecommerce/client" "npm run dev --prefix ecommerce/server"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sentinel && npm run build:tilda
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && python3 -m unittest discover -s services/ai-engine/tests && npm test --prefix ecommerce/server && npm test --prefix ecommerce/client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix ecommerce/client && npm install --prefix ecommerce/server && npm install --prefix recovery-controller
